mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS both above their 50th percentile does not produce positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) alongside rising employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth accelerates.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.5%, the joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS does not produce positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates stronger manufacturing and supply chain activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 1,000,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.0%, a rising UNRATE does not produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rising does not produce negative 5-day returns in at least 60% of cases.
